name: ProgressBar
description: Mortar foundation progress bar, using central semantic tokens.

props.label: string
props.tone: neutral | info | success | warning | danger (Tone; omit for the accent colour)

contract.usage: Import { ProgressBar } from @tonycodes-ui/mortar. Use it for the progress of a task, such as an upload or a setup checklist. For a measured amount against a capacity, such as storage or a quota, use Meter from @tonycodes-ui/mortar/charts.
contract.avoid: Do not copy implementations, override central colours or grant component approval.
contract.accessibility: Verify accessible names, keyboard interaction, visible focus, responsive layout and supported states.
